content: Dɑfidi u kuɑ
Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑn sunɔ
Isirelibɑn bwesenu kpuro nu mɛnnɑ nu nɑ Dɑfidin mi Heboroniɔ, bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɛsɛ kɑ wunɛ sɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ yɛm tem.
Bɑɑ yellun di sɑɑ ye Sɔɔlu u wɑ̃ɑ u sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn sunɔ, wunɑ ɑ rɑ sun mɛnnɛ ɑ sun kpɑrɑ su kɑ tɑbu dɑ su kɑ wurɑmɑ. Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nun sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɑ wunɑ kɑɑ ko bɛsɛn wiruɡii kpɑ ɑ bɛsɛ win tɔmbu kpɑrɑ.
Dɑfidi u kɑ ben ɡuro ɡurobu ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ Heboroni mi. Yerɑ bɑ nùn ɡum tɑ̃re wirɔ bɑ nùn kuɑ be Isirelibɑn sunɔ.

Dɑfidi u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ sɑɑ yè sɔɔ u bɑn dibu toruɑ. U kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sunɔ wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑ suru nɔɔbɑ tiɑ Heboroniɔ. Mɑ u mɑɑ bɑndu di Yerusɑlɛmuɔ wɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ kɑ itɑ. Yudɑbɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron suunu sɔɔ u kuɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ weeru bɑndu sɔɔ.
Dɑfidi u Yerusɑlɛmu mwɑ
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Dɑfidi sinɑ boko u seewɑ kɑ win tɔmbu bɑ dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bu kɑ Yebusibɑ tɑbu wɔri. Adɑmɑ Yebusi be, bɑ nɛɛ, u ǹ kpɛ̃ u du mi. Domi bɑɑ wɔ̃kobu kɑ yɛmɔbu bɑ koo nùn ɡirɑ.
Adɑmɑ Dɑfidi u ben kɑri ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ wuu ɡen suunu sɔɔ wɔri u mwɑ. N deemɑ yeyɑ bɑ mɔ̀ Siɔni. Yen biru bɑ ye sokɑ Dɑfidin wuu.

Tɔ̃ɔ teyɑ Dɑfidi u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛn bɑɑwure wi u kĩ u Yebusibɑ ɡo, u duo ben nim swɑɑ ye bɑ ɡbɑn min di kpɑ u wɔ̃kobu kɑ yɛmɔ be, be nɑ tusɑ mi nɔmɑ turi. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ rɑ nɛɛ, wɔ̃kobu kɑ yɛmɔbu bɑ ǹ duɔ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Ye Dɑfidi u kɑri ye mwɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ u sinɑ mi. Mɑ bɑ ye sokɑ Dɑfidin wuu. Yerɑ u ɡbɑ̃rɑru bɑnɑ sɑɑ win tiin yɛnun di u kɑ dɑ sere bɑtumɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Miloɔ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Dɑfidin bɑndɑ dɑm sosimɔ tɑ dɔɔwɑ. Domi Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wi.
Yerɑ Tirin sunɔ wi bɑ mɔ̀ Hirɑmu u Dɑfidi sɔmɔbu ɡɔriɑ kɑ dɑ̃ɑ ɡeɑ ye bɑ sokumɔ sɛduru, kɑ sere mɑɑ dɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃kobu kɑ be bɑ rɑ mɑɑ kpenu dɑ̃ku. Kpɑ bu nùn sinɑ kpɑɑru bɑniɑ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u tubɑ mɑ Gusunɔwɑ u win bɑndun dɑm siremɔ. Wiyɑ u mɑɑ bɑn te wɔlle suɑmɔ win tɔmbu Isirelibɑn sɔ̃.
Dɑfidin bii be u mɑrɑ
Yerusɑlɛmuɔ
Sɑnɑm mɛ Dɑfidi u doonɑmɑ Heboronin di u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, yerɑ u mɑɑ kurɔbu ɡɑbu suɑ mɑ bɑ nùn bii tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu mɑruɑ.
Berɑ Sɑmuɑ kɑ Sobɑbu kɑ Nɑtɑni kɑ Sɑlomɔɔ
kɑ Yibɑɑ kɑ Elisuɑ kɑ Nɛfɛɡi kɑ Yɑfiɑ
kɑ Elisɑmɑ kɑ Eliɑdɑ kɑ Elifelɛti.
Dɑfidi u Filisitibɑ tɑbu di
Ye Filisitibɑ bɑ nuɑ bɑ Dɑfidi ɡum tɑ̃re wirɔ u kuɑ Isirelibɑn sunɔ, yerɑ be kpuro bɑ seewɑ bɑ nùn wɔrim wee. Ye u nuɑ mɛ, mɑ u sɑrɑ u dɑ kuku yeru ɡɑrun mi, mi bɑ ǹ nùn wɑsi.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Filisiti be, bɑ tunumɑ bɑ tɛriɑ Refɑn wɔwɑɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, n doo n Filisiti be wɔri? Kɑɑ mɑn bu nɔmu bɛriɑ? Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo, kon nun bu nɔmu bɛriɑ.

Mɑ Dɑfidi u seewɑ u dɑ Bɑɑli Perɑsimuɔ. Miyɑ u Filisiti be ɡo ɡo. Mɑ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛn yibɛrɛbɑn wuuru ɡĩɑ nɡe mɛ nim torɑ yɑ rɑ ɡunɑ ɡĩɛ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ yɑm mi yĩsiru kɑ̃ Bɑɑli Perɑsimu.
Yerɑ Filisiti be, bɑ duki suɑ bɑ ben bwɑ̃ɑrokunu deri mi. Mɑ Dɑfidi kɑ win tɔmbu bɑ nu ɡurɑ.
Amɛn biru Filisiti be, bɑ kpɑm nɑ bɑ tɛriɑ Refɑn wɔwɑ mi.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, n doo n bu wɔri kpɑm? Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, oo, ɑdɑmɑ ɑ ku dɑ sɔru sɔrum mɛ. A besiro kpɑ ɑ dɑ ben biruɔ, ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ miren sɔ̃ɔwɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ nɑɑ dɑmu dɑmusu ɡɑsu nɔɔmɔ dɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ, ɑ wɑsi suo, domi nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ nun ɡbiiye n kɑ ben sɑnsɑni wɔri.
Dɑfidi u kuɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U dɑ u Filisiti be ɡo ɡo sɑɑ Gebɑn di u kɑ dɑ Gesɛɛɔ.
